turns.content: My manager has been bullying me for eight months. Constant criticism, public humiliation, impossible deadlines.
Workplace bullying from a manager is particularly hard to escape. Have you been able to escalate it to HR?
I tried. HR sided with my manager. I feel completely trapped. I need the job but going in every day is destroying me.
Feeling trapped in a toxic environment with no recourse — that's a form of sustained stress that has real consequences. How is it affecting you outside work?
I'm a shell at home. I don't talk to my partner. I've been having panic attacks. I've started to think I'm worthless, that my manager is right about me.
Internalising a bully's narrative as truth is one of the most damaging effects of sustained abuse. Are you having any darker thoughts?
I've been thinking about not being here. Not a plan, but a wish. I wake up and feel disappointed I have to go through another day.
Wishing you didn't wake up is a form of passive suicidal ideation. How long has that been happening?
About a month. It's getting more frequent. I'm scared of where this is heading.
